## Fieldnotes is complete

The completed application and [FINAL.md](sandbox:/workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w09/FINAL.md) are saved in the assigned work package.

Fieldnotes uses **Vanilla Paper 0.10.0** as its complete visual foundation, with its own Day and Night palettes, warm reading sheets, serif reading type, distinct interface type, red margin rule and ruled editor. Always-visible note actions and sticky titles use supported theme options.

I inspected both original demos and equivalent local trials of **Vanilla Paper** and **Notebook 1.4.1** before selecting Paper. Paper’s reading measure and editorial treatment better fit the research-studio brief; its tradeoff is more vertical scrolling.

### Run

```bash
cd /workspace/scratch/708e8b7f118e/ui-study/worksets/w09/app
FONTCONFIG_FILE=/tmp/ui-spec-fonts/fonts.conf PORT=4409 ./start.sh
```

Open [http://127.0.0.1:4409/](http://127.0.0.1:4409/). The preview server is stopped, as required by run control. The native TiddlyWiki client/server application remains authoritative. The offline export was also built successfully at `app/wiki/output/index.html`.

| English and Chinese edits | Native save, browser reload and filesystem readback agree |
